description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Kykar.
Kykar and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve View from Above, giving Kykar flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
